@about: Circuit simulation add-on (0.9 SU.1084). Words of the add-on only; English first, the language round is lang-final-09's.
circuit.name: Circuit simulation
circuit.noproblems: The circuit passes the rule check.
circuit.honesty: Our own solver, checked against closed forms. You type every part value; no maker's part models are read or included, and Multisim files cannot be opened.
circuit.cmd.opened: The Circuit simulation window is open.
circuit.cmd.help: Open the Circuit simulation window: draw a schematic and simulate it.
ed.name: Net name
ed.hint.select: Click a pin, then another pin, to draw a wire. Drag a part to move it. R turns it, Delete removes it.
ed.hint.place: Click the drawing to place a {part}. Esc stops.
ed.hint.name: Click a pin to give its net a name. A net named 0 or gnd is ground.
ed.hint.wire: Click a pin to end the wire, empty space for a junction, or a wire to join it. Double-click or Esc stops.
ed.name.label: Net name at {pin}
ed.nosel: Select a part to change its value.
ed.wire.selected: A wire is selected. Delete removes it.
chk.noground: The circuit has no ground. Place a Ground symbol or name a net 0 or gnd.
chk.floating: {tag} pin {pin} is not connected to anything.
chk.twonames: The nets {names} are joined by wiring: one of them is a short or a wrong name.
chk.dcpath: The net {node} has no DC path to ground, so its voltage is not fixed by the circuit. Add a resistor to ground or a bias path.
chk.sourceloop: {tag} closes a loop of voltage sources and inductors; the current in the loop is undefined. Put a small resistor in the loop.
chk.shorted: {tag} has both ends on one net.
netlist.badvalue: {tag}: {field} is "{text}", which is not a number. Use 4.7k, 100n, 1meg (m is milli, meg is mega).
netlist.notpositive: {tag}: {field} is "{text}"; it must be above zero.
netlist.element: {tag} could not be added to the circuit: {why}
run.empty: The drawing is empty. Place some parts, or load the example.
run.badtime: The stop time and the step must be numbers above zero.
run.toomanysteps: That is more than {max} steps. Use a larger step or a shorter stop time.
run.badfreq: The sweep needs a start above zero and an end above the start.
run.toomanypoints: That is more than {max} frequencies. Use fewer points per decade or a shorter range.
run.noacsource: No source has an AC size. Set "AC size for the sweep" on a DC or pulse source, or use an AC source.
run.noscope: Place a scope on a net to see its voltage over time.
run.noplot: Place a plotter on a net to see its response over frequency.
res.currentnote: Current runs through the part from its first pin to its second (a source: from + to -, so a battery that delivers current reads negative).
file.newask: Start a new, empty circuit? The one on the sheet is replaced.
file.dropped: Opened, but {n} items in the file were not valid and were left out.
file.notcircuit: That file is not a Circuit simulation file.
file.version: That file is version {v}; this add-on reads version 1.
file.symbol: A part in the file was not valid and was left out.
file.wire: A wire in the file did not join two pins and was left out.
file.label: A net name in the file was not on a pin and was left out.
